record.question: Employment Exchange under the Employment Exchanges (Compulsory Notification of Vacancies) Act, 1959 means –
options: an establishment which is not in the public sector
an establishment own, controlled and managed by the government
any office or place established and maintained by the government for collecting and furnishing information of potential employees
any office or place where trade, industry, business or occupation is carried on
